description: Inserts a break at an index (or at the end of the body when index is omitted). kind=page starts a new page; kind=section_next_page starts a new section on a new page; kind=section_continuous starts a new section on the same page. Sections carry their own margins/columns — style them via raw_request updateSectionStyle. Breaks cannot be inserted into headers, footers, footnotes or table cells. A break occupies one index position; remove one by deleting its range with delete_range.

document_id.description: The document id — the long id from the document URL (docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit) or from create_document output.

index.description: Insertion index (from read_document_text). Omit to append at the end of the body.

segment_id.description: Header/footer/footnote segment id (from get_document). Omit for the document body.

tab_id.description: Tab to target (from list_tabs). Omit for the first/only tab.

name: insert_break
title: Insert a page or section break
